obligations.expected_behavior: Reconcile the complete current Consumer Manifest bidirectionally with repository callers, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing callers.
forbidden_result: A one-directional reconciliation between the Consumer Manifest and repository callers.
A reconciliation that excludes VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing callers.
A reconciliation that does not cover the complete current Consumer Manifest.
obligations.observable_result: The Consumer Manifest and the repository caller set are mutually reconciled across VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing.
obligations.state_after: The complete current Consumer Manifest is bidirectionally reconciled with the covered repository callers.
obligations.state_before: The reconciliation specified by FR-9 has not yet been established.
obligations.subject: Complete current Consumer Manifest and repository callers
obligations.trigger: When Consumer Manifest reconciliation is performed
